blocks.text: BERLIN, Germany—A survey of soldiers in Germany‘s armed forces showed extensive sexual harassment within the ranks, with women in particular suffering. Defense Minister Boris Pistorius made the revelation on Wednesday. The survey comes with an extensive recruiting effort under way to dramatically grow the ranks of the Bundeswehr, as Germany’s military is known, with hopes in particular of attracting more women to serve. Pistorius said that 38 percent of women in the military reported experiencing verbal sexual harassment, while 10 percent reported physical sexual harassment.
